title: Sampling
description: A Synthesis II class assignment where we were provided a 30 second sample of cows mooing. We were tasked with creating various instruments using this sample and Ableton's Simpler instrument. While not all sounds were pristine, the project was an exercise of scrubbing a sample and dissecting each individual instrument's sound while manipulating sampling, envelope, and filter parameters.
